description:
Reviewed all files in scope for commits 919d3b7 and fe84570:
- crates/transit/src/import/rnews.rs
- crates/transit/src/rnews_config.rs
- crates/transit/src/rnews_main.rs
- crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs
- crates/transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs
- crates/transit/src/import/reindex.rs
- crates/transit/tests/rnews_ingest.rs
- crates/core/src/group_log/types.rs
- crates/core/src/group_log/append.rs
- crates/core/src/group_log/verify.rs
- crates/core/src/group_log/sqlite_storage.rs
- crates/core/src/validation.rs

Checklist results:
1. Silent data loss — none. Articles without Message-ID are correctly counted as rejected (not silently dropped). Compressed batch parser propagates UnsupportedCompression correctly.
2. Panics on well-formed input — none. All arithmetic is checked; unwrap_or_default() on SystemTime gives 0 (not a panic).
3. Byte offset arithmetic — correct. pos += nl+1 advances past the newline; checked_add guards overflow; article_end bounds-checked against input.len().
4. Folded-header fix in pipeline.rs — correct for both Message-ID and Newsgroups cases. Early-exit only fires when current==0 AND both fields already accumulated.
5. HlcTimestamp promotion DB consistency — wall_ms stored as i64, reconstructed with logical=0 node_id=[0;8]. verify_entry monotonicity check still correct: child with same wall_ms but non-zero logical passes (child > db_parent). Negative-ts guard in get_entry prevents silent wrap.
6. validate_message_id <= 0x20 — correct. Covers all C0 controls (0x00-0x1F) plus space (0x20). DEL (0x7F) is rejected separately. Space test confirmed in test suite.
7. EX_TEMPFAIL (75) — only fired when transient > 0. PipelineError::Permanent is counted as rejected, not transient. Correct separation.
8. .take(limit+1) gzip cap — reads exactly limit+1 bytes max, then checks out.len() > limit. Correctly rejects limit+1 bytes. Does not silently truncate (read_to_end is bounded by the take).

One P1 risk filed as stoa-paxfh.8: reindex.rs extract_message_id_bytes does not handle folded Message-ID headers (disaster-recovery path only).
title: S0: no P0 correctness bugs found in rnews commits
